topics.title: Transport as a lifeline and roadways

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why efficient transport and communication are prerequisites for development and trade.
State the reasons for the growing importance of road transport compared with rail.
Classify Indian roads by capacity and identify projects such as the Golden Quadrilateral and PMGSY.
Describe the role of the Indian Railways in the national economy and integration.
Explain how physiographic, economic and administrative factors shape the railway network.
Interpret the gauge-wise distribution of India's railway route length.
Explain the uses, costs and advantages of pipeline transport.
Identify the three important pipeline networks of India and the places they connect.
Identify India's National Waterways and the merits of water transport.
Describe the location and specialisation of India's major sea ports.
Explain the advantages of air transport and schemes such as UDAN and Pawan Hans services.
Describe India's postal network and telecom facilities.
Identify the means and agencies of mass communication in India.
Define international trade and calculate and interpret the balance of trade.
Identify the main commodities exported from and imported to India.
Explain the role of tourism as a trade and the schemes that promote it.
